text: {"lessons":["I tended to sell winners quickly to lock in gains; I should weigh a sale against the stock’s outlook, not just the pleasure of realizing a profit.","I should avoid buying back a stock simply because it has risen; my Stock B purchase at 126.58 calls for a clear reason and plan.","A short-term account-value dip is not by itself a reason to trade; I should review my holdings calmly and make deliberate decisions."]}
